news.verdict: Abbott is a high-quality, diversified healthcare compounder with a strong CGM growth engine in FreeStyle Libre and solid balance sheet, making it suitable for mid-to-long-term investors at reasonable valuations, though the infant formula litigation and post-COVID diagnostic normalization warrant monitoring before initiating or adding to a position.
